description.en: Track brand visibility, position and sentiment across AI search engines.
description.zh: 监测品牌在 AI 搜索中的曝光、位置与情绪倾向。

en: Organize prompts and monitor how your brand appears in AI answers.
Compare competitors and investigate cited sources.
zh: 整理提示词，持续监测品牌在 AI 回答中的表现。
比较竞品并调查被引用的信息来源。

audience.en: Marketing teams building an ongoing AI search reporting workflow.
audience.zh: 需要持续跟踪 AI 搜索表现的营销团队。

description.en: For recurring brand reports, keep a consistent set of buying questions and review how brand mentions and sentiment change in the answers.
description.zh: 定期制作品牌报告时，持续观察同一组购买问题，复查回答中的品牌提及和情绪变化。

summary.en: Recurring brand mention and sentiment reports.
summary.zh: 持续复盘品牌提及与情绪。

description.en: When competitors appear in answers instead of your brand, inspect the cited sources to identify material worth reviewing for your content research.
description.zh: 当回答推荐竞品而未提及自有品牌时，调查被引来源，为后续内容研究确定需复查的资料。

summary.en: Investigate competitors’ cited sources.
summary.zh: 调查竞品的被引来源。

label.zh: Peec AI 官方产品功能
Peec AI 定价与方案
Profound 选型比较依据

description.en: Starter is $95/month for 50 prompts and one project; Pro is $245/month for 150 prompts and two projects; Advanced is $495/month for 350 prompts and five projects. These are monthly brand plans; Enterprise is quoted separately.
description.zh: 品牌月付方案：Starter 为 $95/月，含 50 个提示词和 1 个项目；Pro 为 $245/月，含 150 个提示词和 2 个项目；Advanced 为 $495/月，含 350 个提示词和 5 个项目。Enterprise 单独报价。

summary.en: Starter: $95/month; 50 prompts, one project. Enterprise quoted separately.
summary.zh: Starter $95/月，50 个提示词、1 个项目；企业版另询价。

description.en: Model coverage is selected separately; tracking more models changes usage and pricing.
description.zh: 平台覆盖需单独选择；追踪更多模型会改变用量和计费。

summary.en: Extra models change usage and cost.
summary.zh: 增加模型会改变用量与费用。

description.en: Peec offers self-service monthly brand plans with prompt and project allowances; Profound's public ongoing offer is enterprise-quoted. Compare purchasing scope and included engines, rather than treating their trial offers as equivalent subscriptions.
description.zh: Peec 提供按提示词和项目分档的自助品牌月付方案，Profound 的公开持续服务方案采用企业报价。应比较采购范围与所含引擎，不把两者的试用当作等价订阅。

description.en: Analyze brand mentions, sentiment and discoverability across AI search.
description.zh: 分析品牌在 AI 搜索中的提及、情绪与可发现性。

en: Monitor AI brand mentions and compare your visibility with competitors.
Connect answer insights with AI traffic, crawler analytics and content workflows.
zh: 监测 AI 品牌提及，并与竞品曝光进行比较。
将回答洞察与 AI 流量、爬虫分析和内容工作流结合。

audience.en: Brand and marketing teams evaluating AI search at enterprise scale.
audience.zh: 评估企业级 AI 搜索表现的品牌与营销团队。

description.en: For enterprise brand reviews, compare your brand with competitors in AI answers and examine differences in mentions and sentiment.
description.zh: 开展企业品牌复盘时，对比自有品牌与竞品在 AI 回答中的提及和情绪差异。

summary.en: Compare enterprise brand mentions and sentiment.
summary.zh: 比较企业品牌与竞品的提及及情绪。

description.en: When reviewing AI discovery across teams, examine answer insights alongside referral traffic and crawler analytics rather than treating mentions as visits.
description.zh: 跨团队复盘 AI 发现渠道时，结合回答洞察、引荐流量与爬虫分析，分别判断提及、访问和抓取情况。

summary.en: Review answers alongside referrals and bot activity.
summary.zh: 结合回答、引荐与爬虫活动复盘。

label.zh: Profound 官方产品功能
Profound 定价与方案
Peec AI 选型比较依据

description.en: The public offer lists a seven-day trial and a custom-priced Enterprise package. No fixed recurring Enterprise amount is published; request a quote for the required tracking and AI Marketer credits.
description.zh: 公开方案包括七天试用和定制报价的 Enterprise；未公布固定企业月费，需按监测范围及 AI Marketer 积分要求获取报价。

summary.en: Enterprise quote; seven-day prompt-tracking trial.
summary.zh: 企业版询价；提示词追踪可试用七天。

description.en: Prompt tracking has a seven-day trial; enterprise engine coverage is defined by the sales agreement.
description.zh: 提示词追踪提供七天试用；企业引擎覆盖以销售协议为准。

summary.en: Enterprise engine coverage is contract-defined.
summary.zh: 企业引擎覆盖以合同为准。

description.en: Compared with Peec's published self-service brand tiers, Profound's ongoing package is tailored around enterprise monitoring and AI Marketer credits. Request a scoped quote before comparing total cost.
description.zh: 与 Peec 公开的自助品牌档位相比，Profound 的持续服务围绕企业监测与 AI Marketer 积分定制。比较总成本前，应先取得范围明确的报价。

description.en: Monitor brand mentions and the source links cited in AI search answers.
description.zh: 监测 AI 搜索回答中的品牌提及与引用链接。

en: Track mentions and cited source links for your monitored prompts.
Explore prompt research, competitive visibility and GEO audit recommendations.
zh: 跟踪监测提示词下的品牌提及与引用来源链接。
研究提示词、竞品曝光与 GEO 诊断建议。

audience.en: SEO specialists and agencies tracking how brands are cited in AI answers.
audience.zh: 需要追踪品牌引用情况的 SEO 从业者与代理机构。

description.en: When reporting how a brand is referenced, review monitored answers to distinguish a name mention from a link to a cited page.
description.zh: 汇报品牌被引用的情况时，检查监测到的回答，区分仅提到品牌名称和实际引用网页链接。

summary.en: Distinguish brand mentions from cited links.
summary.zh: 区分品牌提及与网页引用。

label.zh: OtterlyAI 官方产品功能
OtterlyAI 定价与方案
OtterlyAI 当前定价

description.en: Monthly Lite, Standard and Premium plans are $29, $189 and $489 respectively, with 15, 100 and 400 search prompts. Annual billing is listed separately; extra engines and prompt capacity can cost more.
description.zh: Lite、Standard、Premium 的月付价格分别为 $29、$189、$489，含 15、100、400 个搜索提示词。年付另列，额外引擎和提示词额度可能另收费。

summary.en: Lite: $29/month, 15 prompts; Standard: $189/month, 100 prompts. Annual plans separate.
summary.zh: Lite $29/月、15 个提示词；Standard $189/月、100 个。年付另列。

description.en: Google AI Mode, Gemini and Claude monitoring are paid add-ons.
description.zh: Google AI Mode、Gemini 和 Claude 监控需要付费加购。

summary.en: AI Mode, Gemini and Claude cost extra.
summary.zh: AI Mode、Gemini、Claude 需另购。

description.en: Compare the full engine mix, not only Lite's entry price: AI Mode, Gemini and Claude are paid add-ons, and the 15-prompt Lite allowance is smaller than Standard's 100.
description.zh: 选型应比较完整引擎组合，而非只看 Lite 起步价：AI Mode、Gemini 和 Claude 需付费加购，Lite 的 15 个提示词额度也小于 Standard 的 100 个。

description.en: Explore the citations and sources shaping your brand’s AI search presence.
description.zh: 探索影响品牌 AI 搜索表现的引用与信息来源。

en: Measure brand visibility, mentions, citations and sentiment in AI search.
Investigate sources and competitors to inform content and optimization actions.
zh: 测量 AI 搜索中的品牌曝光、提及、引用与情绪。
研究来源与竞品，为内容和优化行动提供参考。

audience.en: Marketing teams connecting citation analysis with content decisions.
audience.zh: 希望将引用分析用于内容决策的营销团队。

description.en: Before planning content updates, investigate which sources and competitors appear in AI answers and use the findings to frame editorial work.
description.zh: 规划内容更新前，调查 AI 回答中的来源与竞品，用这些线索确定编辑工作的方向。

summary.en: Use citations and competitors to plan content updates.
summary.zh: 依据引用和竞品线索规划内容更新。

label.zh: AthenaHQ 官方产品功能
AthenaHQ 定价与方案

description.en: Starter is listed at $295/month with 3,600 credits. The Essential offer includes $25 in introductory credit; this does not establish a recurring free monitoring allowance. Enterprise pricing is custom.
description.zh: Starter 标价 $295/月，含 3,600 积分。Essential 提供 $25 初始体验额度，不代表每月持续免费的监测配额；Enterprise 定制报价。

summary.en: Starter: $295/month, 3,600 credits. Essential's $25 credit is introductory.
summary.zh: Starter $295/月、3,600 积分；Essential 的 $25 额度仅为初始体验。

description.en: Paid plans expand engine coverage; the Essential offer lists introductory credits rather than a confirmed recurring free allowance.
description.zh: 付费方案扩展平台覆盖；Essential 标注的是初始免费额度，未确认有周期性免费配额。

summary.en: No verified recurring free allowance; engine coverage varies by plan.
summary.zh: 未确认持续免费额度；引擎覆盖随套餐变化。

description.en: Evaluate credits and selected engine coverage together. Essential's introductory credit is for evaluation; recurring monitoring should be assessed against the paid package and actual engine requirements.
description.zh: 应同时评估积分和所选引擎覆盖。Essential 初始积分用于体验，持续监测应按付费套餐及实际引擎需求选型。

description.en: Follow your prompts to find brand mentions and gaps in AI visibility.
description.zh: 围绕提示词追踪品牌提及与 AI 曝光缺口。

en: Monitor brand mentions, competitors, citations and sentiment across supported AI engines.
Review website analytics and AI crawler activity alongside prompt responses.
zh: 监控支持平台上的品牌提及、竞品、引用和情绪。
结合提示词回答查看网站分析与 AI 爬虫活动。

audience.en: Teams maintaining a repeatable set of business-relevant prompts.
audience.zh: 需要持续监测业务相关提示词的团队。

description.en: When investigating a change in AI visibility, review monitored answers alongside website analytics and AI crawler activity.
description.zh: 调查 AI 曝光变化时，结合监测到的回答、网站分析和 AI 爬虫活动查找线索。

summary.en: Investigate visibility changes with answers, traffic and crawler data.
summary.zh: 结合回答、流量及爬虫数据调查曝光变化。

label.zh: Promptmonitor 官方产品功能
Promptmonitor 定价与方案

description.en: Monthly Starter, Growth and Pro plans are $39, $79 and $149. Their cards list 25, 50 and 150 tracked prompts. The lower headline starting price uses yearly billing rather than the monthly Starter price.
description.zh: Starter、Growth、Pro 月付分别为 $39、$79、$149，套餐卡分别列出 25、50、150 个监测提示词。较低的首页起步价采用年付口径，不能当作 Starter 月付价。

summary.en: Monthly Starter: $39/25 prompts; Growth: $79/50; Pro: $149/150.
summary.zh: 月付 Starter $39/25 个提示词，Growth $79/50 个，Pro $149/150 个。

description.en: The pricing FAQ limits Starter to ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity; other plan descriptions conflict on coverage, frequency and seats, so confirm these limits before subscribing.
description.zh: 定价 FAQ 将 Starter 限于 ChatGPT、Gemini 和 Perplexity；其他方案说明在平台、频率及席位上存在出入，订阅前需确认限制。

summary.en: Starter: ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity. Confirm conflicting cadence and seat descriptions.
summary.zh: Starter 覆盖 ChatGPT、Gemini、Perplexity；频率与席位说明有出入，需确认。

description.en: Compare the selected plan's prompt cadence, websites and seats. Starter and Growth differ in semi-weekly versus daily tracking, and conflicting engine descriptions should be confirmed before subscribing.
description.zh: 按所选套餐的提示词频率、网站数和席位比较。Starter 与 Growth 存在每周两次与每日追踪的差别，页面有出入的引擎说明需在订阅前确认。

description.en: Track brand mentions and citations across the prompts you care about.
description.zh: 围绕关心的提示词，追踪品牌提及与引用。

en: Monitor whether AI answers mention or cite your brand, and inspect the underlying sources.
Configure prompt counts, daily, weekly or monthly refresh, and the engines to monitor.
zh: 监测 AI 回答是否提及或引用品牌，并查看底层来源。
配置提示词数量、每日／每周／每月刷新频率及监测引擎。

audience.en: SEO and content teams studying visibility changes over time.
audience.zh: 研究曝光变化的 SEO 与内容团队。

description.en: For a recurring monitoring schedule, select questions, engines and refresh frequency, then review whether answers mention or cite the brand.
description.zh: 建立持续监测计划时，选择问题、引擎和刷新频率，再复查回答是否提及或引用品牌。

summary.en: Monitor brand mentions and citations on a set schedule.
summary.zh: 按选定频率监测提及和引用。

label.zh: ZipTie 官方产品功能
ZipTie 定价与方案

description.en: Pricing is configured by prompts, engines and refresh frequency. One prompt on one engine for one check is listed at $0.01; content generation adds $20/month per context and API/MCP access adds $10/month. The preset headline is not a universal flat plan.
description.zh: 按提示词、引擎及刷新频率组合计费。一个提示词在一个引擎检查一次标价 $0.01；内容生成每个 context 加 $20/月，API／MCP 访问加 $10/月。预设起步价不是适用于所有配置的固定套餐价。

summary.en: $0.01 per prompt/engine/check; content +$20/context/month; API/MCP +$10/month.
summary.zh: 每提示词／引擎／检查 $0.01；内容每 context 加 $20/月，API／MCP 加 $10/月。

description.en: Content Generation, UGC Impact Analysis and API/MCP access are optional paid add-ons.
description.zh: 内容生成、UGC 影响分析和 API／MCP 访问为可选付费附加项。

summary.en: Content, UGC analysis and API/MCP are paid add-ons.
summary.zh: 内容、UGC 分析及 API／MCP 为付费附加项。

description.en: Choose a configuration by engine, prompt volume and cadence rather than by preset name. Add content generation or API/MCP only if required, since they change the configured bill.
description.zh: 应按引擎、提示词数量与频率选择配置，而非只按预设名称选购。仅在确有需要时增加内容生成或 API／MCP，因为这些会改变账单。

description.en: Compare brand mentions, citations and sentiment across AI search engines.
description.zh: 比较不同 AI 搜索平台上的品牌提及、引用与情绪。

en: Track brand mentions, rankings, citations and sentiment across AI engines.
Investigate competitors and sources alongside prompt research and page audits.
zh: 跟踪各 AI 平台的品牌提及、排名、引用与情绪。
结合提示词研究和页面诊断，分析竞品及引用来源。

audience.en: Marketers and agencies comparing brands across a defined prompt set.
audience.zh: 需要在指定提示词范围比较品牌表现的营销人员与代理机构。

description.en: When investigating a visibility gap, combine prompt research, competitor answers and cited sources with page-audit findings.
description.zh: 调查曝光缺口时，将提示词研究、竞品回答和引用来源与页面诊断结果一起复查。

summary.en: Combine citation research with page audits.
summary.zh: 结合引用研究与页面诊断调查曝光缺口。

label.zh: Rankscale 官方产品功能
Rankscale 定价与方案

description.en: Pro is listed at $99/month with 1,200 credits, and Pro+ at $229/month with 3,000 credits. Essentials has a lower starting offer marked yearly only; compare its billing term and capacity separately.
description.zh: Pro 标价 $99/月，含 1,200 积分；Pro+ 为 $229/月，含 3,000 积分。更低的 Essentials 起步方案标明仅限年付，需单独比较账期与额度。

summary.en: Pro: $99/month, 1,200 credits. Lower-priced Essentials is annual-only.
summary.zh: Pro $99/月、1,200 积分；较低价 Essentials 仅限年付。

description.en: Monitoring uses credits; frequency, engines and other operations determine consumption.
description.zh: 监测使用积分计量，运行频率、引擎和其他操作会影响消耗。

summary.en: Engine, frequency and operations affect credit usage.
summary.zh: 引擎、频率和操作都会消耗积分。

description.en: For dashboard research, compare credit capacity and page audits; for programmatic reporting, check the Pro+ REST API entitlement. Unlimited search-term creation does not mean unlimited executions.
description.zh: 看板研究应比较积分容量和页面诊断；需要程序化报表时则核对 Pro+ 的 REST API 权限。可无限创建搜索词不代表可无限执行。

description.en: Benchmark competitors and discover which sources appear in AI answers.
description.zh: 对比竞品表现，发现 AI 回答中的引用来源。

en: Track keyword-based brand visibility and generate related prompts.
Compare share of voice and position metrics, and analyze cited sources.
zh: 围绕关键词追踪品牌曝光，并生成相关提示词。
比较声量份额与位置指标，分析引用来源。

audience.en: SEO teams that want a keyword-led approach to AI search comparisons.
audience.zh: 希望用关键词组织 AI 搜索对比的 SEO 团队。

description.en: When researching a keyword topic, use related prompts to compare brand presence and examine which sources are cited in answers.
description.zh: 研究某个关键词主题时，通过相关提示词比较品牌呈现，并检查回答引用了哪些来源。

summary.en: Explore keyword topics through generated prompts and citations.
summary.zh: 围绕关键词研究相关提示词和引用。

label.zh: LLMrefs 官方产品功能

description.en: The All in One offer is displayed at $79/month and marked limited time, with a seven-day trial. Treat this as the observed promotional offer, not a guaranteed permanent list price.
description.zh: All in One 页面显示 $79/月并标注限时优惠，另有七天试用。这里记录的是本次看到的促销报价，不代表永久标准价。

summary.en: All in One: $79/month promotional offer; seven-day trial.
summary.zh: All in One 限时优惠 $79/月；可试用七天。

description.en: Mentions, positions and citation share describe the monitored answer sample; they do not establish visits or sales, and the generated prompts should be reviewed for your research scope.
description.zh: 提及、位置和引用份额描述的是所监测回答样本，不代表访问或销量；生成的提示词仍需按研究范围复核。

summary.en: Sample visibility is not traffic or sales; review generated prompts.
summary.zh: 样本曝光不等于流量或销量；生成的问题需复核。

description.en: Its keyword-led workflow generates related prompts for visibility research. Review that generated question set against your business questions before comparing its share-of-voice numbers with a fixed-prompt monitoring project.
description.zh: 其工作流从关键词生成相关提示词，适合曝光研究。与固定提示词项目比较声量份额前，应先核对生成的问题集合是否覆盖自身业务问题。

description.en: Identify website barriers that affect AI discovery and interpretation.
description.zh: 发现影响 AI 发现与理解网站的内容和技术障碍。

en: Evaluate how website pages are optimized for AI visibility with Site Audit.
Use page-level findings to identify technical and content optimization opportunities.
zh: 使用 Site Audit 评估页面针对 AI 曝光的优化情况。
通过页面级发现定位技术与内容优化机会。

audience.en: Website and marketing teams investigating AI discovery issues.
audience.zh: 需要调查 AI 发现问题的网站与营销团队。

description.en: Before assigning technical or editorial fixes, use page-level Site Audit findings to identify the pages and issues to review.
description.zh: 分派技术或编辑修复工作前，通过 Site Audit 的页面级发现，定位需要复查的页面和问题。

summary.en: Locate page-level technical and content issues.
summary.zh: 定位页面级技术和内容问题。

label.zh: Scrunch 官方功能文档
Scrunch 定价与方案

description.en: The official FAQ lists brand Core at $250/month and Agency Core at $500/month. Enterprise and Agency Enterprise use custom pricing. Brand Core includes 125 unique prompts and five site audits per month.
description.zh: 官方 FAQ 列出品牌 Core 为 $250/月，Agency Core 为 $500/月；Enterprise 与 Agency Enterprise 定制报价。品牌 Core 含 125 个独立提示词及每月 5 次网站诊断。

summary.en: Brand Core: $250/month, 125 prompts, five audits/month. Agency Core: $500/month.
summary.zh: 品牌 Core $250/月，125 个提示词、每月 5 次诊断；代理版 Core $500/月。

description.en: Core lists four AI platforms; Enterprise expands coverage to nine, so engine access depends on the plan.
description.zh: Core 列出四个 AI 平台，Enterprise 扩大至九个，具体引擎访问取决于方案。

summary.en: Core lists four engines; Enterprise up to nine, subject to plan.
summary.zh: Core 列出 4 个引擎；企业版扩大至 9 个，以套餐为准。

description.en: Separate brand Core from Agency Core and Enterprise when comparing prices. For page remediation, confirm the included site-audit allowance and which findings identify a specific page.
description.zh: 比较价格时应区分品牌 Core、Agency Core 和 Enterprise。若目标是页面修复，需确认包含的网站诊断次数，以及结果能否定位具体页面。

description.en: Audit your site’s AI search readiness and find areas to improve.
description.zh: 诊断网站的 AI 搜索就绪情况并发现改进方向。

en: Run GEO audits covering content structure, citation signals and technical optimization.
Explore content checks and AI visibility monitoring as part of its GEO toolkit.
zh: 围绕内容结构、引用信号及技术优化运行 GEO 诊断。
使用 GEO 工具集中的内容检查与 AI 曝光监控能力。

audience.en: Website owners looking for an initial GEO diagnostic workflow.
audience.zh: 希望开展初步 GEO 诊断的网站所有者。

description.en: When reviewing a page for AI discovery, inspect its content structure, citation signals and technical issues through a GEO audit.
description.zh: 检查页面的 AI 可发现性时，通过 GEO 诊断复查内容结构、引用信号和技术问题。

summary.en: Audit content structure, citations and technical readiness.
summary.zh: 诊断内容结构、引用及技术问题。

label.zh: Geoptie 官方产品功能

description.en: The plan cards list Starter at $49/month, Professional at $99/month and Enterprise at $399/month, with 15, 100 and 400 prompts. Annual billing is a separate option with two months free; confirm the selected billing period before purchase.
description.zh: 套餐卡列出 Starter $49/月、Professional $99/月、Enterprise $399/月，分别含 15、100、400 个提示词。另有年付送两个月的选项，购买前需核对所选账期。

summary.en: Starter $49/month/15 prompts; Professional $99/100; Enterprise $399/400. Annual option separate.
summary.zh: Starter $49/月/15 个提示词；Professional $99/100 个；Enterprise $399/400 个。年付另选。

description.en: Paid plans let each brand select four of seven listed engines; API access and white-label reports depend on the plan.
description.zh: 付费方案允许每个品牌从列出的七个平台中选择四个；API 与白标报告取决于方案。

summary.en: Four of seven engines per brand; API and white label depend on plan.
summary.zh: 每品牌七选四引擎；API、白标按套餐提供。

description.en: Starter suits a small prompt set; Professional adds more brands, white-label reports and API/MCP access. All tiers select four of seven engines per brand, so a higher tier does not mean all seven run at once.
description.zh: Starter 面向较小提示词集合；Professional 增加品牌额度、白标报告及 API／MCP。各档每品牌都是七选四引擎，更高档不代表七个同时追踪。

description.en: Improve content structure and coverage for AI-generated search answers.
description.zh: 改进内容结构与信息覆盖，使其更适用于 AI 搜索回答。

en: Use the Action Center to locate content gaps, title mismatches, missing FAQs and structured-data issues by page.
Review suggested fixes and export optimization reports; automated recommendations still require editorial fact-checking.
zh: 通过 Action Center 按页面定位内容缺口、标题不匹配、缺失的 FAQ 与结构化数据问题。
审核修复建议并导出优化报告；自动建议仍需编辑核对事实。

audience.en: Content and marketing teams adapting their editorial workflow to AI search.
audience.zh: 希望让编辑流程适应 AI 搜索的内容与营销团队。

description.en: When refreshing an existing page, use Action Center findings to review missing topics, mismatched headings and FAQ or structured-data gaps before approving edits.
description.zh: 更新已有页面时，依据 Action Center 的发现复查主题缺口、标题不匹配及 FAQ 或结构化数据问题，再审核修改。

summary.en: Review page gaps, headings, FAQs and structured-data fixes.
summary.zh: 复查页面缺口、标题、FAQ 和结构化数据修复。

label.zh: Writesonic Action Center 内容检查与导出

label.zh: Writesonic GEO 设置、提示词与竞品分析

label.zh: Writesonic GEO 定价与平台覆盖

description.en: The annual-billing display lists Starter at $79/month, Basic at $199/month and Growth at $399/month. These are effective monthly rates billed annually. Growth is the card that explicitly lists Action Center; do not assume the Starter price includes every optimization feature.
description.zh: 年付显示 Starter 折算 $79/月、Basic $199/月、Growth $399/月，均为按年结算的月度折算价。Growth 套餐卡明确列出 Action Center，不应把 Starter 起步价理解为包含全部优化功能。

summary.en: Annual rates: Starter $79/month; Growth with Action Center $399/month.
summary.zh: 年付折算：Starter $79/月；含 Action Center 的 Growth $399/月。

description.en: Current self-service plans list ChatGPT, Gemini and Google AI Overviews; Enterprise offers broader coverage, with action and content allowances varying by plan.
description.zh: 当前自助套餐列明 ChatGPT、Gemini 和 Google AI Overviews；Enterprise 提供更广覆盖，操作与内容额度随方案变化。

summary.en: Self-service lists three engines; Enterprise expands coverage. Action quotas vary.
summary.zh: 自助套餐列出 3 个引擎；企业版扩大覆盖，操作额度按档位区分。

description.en: Choose by the action workflow you need, not only the cheapest tracking price. Growth explicitly lists Action Center, whereas Starter is positioned around entry-level tracking, articles and site audits.
description.zh: 应按所需行动流程选型，不能只比较最低监测价。Growth 明确包含 Action Center，Starter 则围绕入门追踪、文章和网站诊断。

description.en: Optimize content coverage and follow brand visibility in AI search.
description.zh: 优化内容信息覆盖，并追踪品牌在 AI 搜索中的曝光。

en: Use the Content Editor to improve outlines, topical coverage and internal links.
Pair content optimization with AI Tracker to inspect brand mentions and citations.
zh: 使用内容编辑器改善提纲、主题覆盖与内部链接。
结合 AI Tracker 查看品牌提及与引用情况。

audience.en: Editors and SEO teams that combine content optimization with AI monitoring.
audience.zh: 需要结合内容优化和 AI 监控的编辑与 SEO 团队。

description.en: When revising an article, review topic coverage and internal links in the editor, then use AI Tracker separately to inspect brand mentions and citations.
description.zh: 修改文章时，在编辑器中复查主题覆盖与内部链接，再通过独立的 AI Tracker 查看品牌提及和引用。

summary.en: Edit topic coverage and links; inspect AI mentions separately.
summary.zh: 优化主题覆盖和内链，并查看 AI 品牌提及。

description.zh: 年付方案中，AI Search Analytics 折算 82 美元/月、Standard 99 美元/月、Pro 182 美元/月。独立分析方案与内容加监测方案的提示词额度和刷新频率不同。

summary.en: Annual rates: analytics USD 82/month; Standard USD 99; Pro USD 182.
summary.zh: 年付折算：独立分析 82 美元/月，Standard 99 美元，Pro 182 美元。

description.en: AI Tracker on Standard is limited to ChatGPT with weekly refresh; higher plans list broader access and daily refresh.
description.zh: Standard 的 AI Tracker 仅限 ChatGPT 且每周刷新；较高方案列出更广覆盖与每日刷新。

summary.en: Standard: ChatGPT, weekly. Higher plans offer broader, daily tracking.
summary.zh: Standard 仅 ChatGPT、每周刷新；高档提供更广覆盖及每日追踪。

description.en: Choose AI Search Analytics for a tracking-focused purchase; compare Standard or Pro when content editing is also needed. Standard's 25 weekly prompts differ from the analytics plan's 50 daily prompts despite the higher bundle price.
description.zh: 以追踪为主时可比较 AI Search Analytics；同时需要内容编辑时再比较 Standard 或 Pro。Standard 的 25 个每周提示词与独立分析方案的 50 个每日提示词不同，组合价更高不等于追踪额度更大。

description.en: Measure website visits referred by ChatGPT and other AI assistants.
description.zh: 统计由 ChatGPT 等 AI 助手带来的网站访问。

en: Group recognized referrers such as ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini and Copilot into the AI Assistants acquisition channel.
Filter by AI sources to inspect landing pages, engagement and goal conversions; conversion attribution uses the last visit source.
zh: 将 ChatGPT、Claude、Perplexity、Gemini 和 Copilot 等已识别来源归入 AI Assistants 获客渠道。
按 AI 来源筛选落地页、互动和目标转化；转化归因使用促成转化的最后一次访问来源。

audience.en: Website owners measuring AI referral visits rather than brand mentions.
audience.zh: 希望衡量 AI 实际引荐访问的网站所有者。

description.en: When evaluating AI referrals, filter recognized AI Assistants visits by landing page and goal conversion; visits without referrer data may remain unattributed.
description.zh: 评估 AI 引荐效果时，按落地页和目标转化筛选已识别的 AI Assistants 访问；缺少来源信息的访问可能无法归入该渠道。

summary.en: Measure recognized AI referrals, landing pages and conversions.
summary.zh: 分析已识别的 AI 引荐、落地页和转化。

label.zh: Plausible AI Assistants 渠道与归因限制

description.en: At the displayed tier of up to 10,000 monthly pageviews, Starter, Growth and Business show $9, $14 and $19/month. Pricing scales with pageviews and features; yearly billing is a separate option, and all plans have a 30-day trial.
description.zh: 页面所示每月不超过 10,000 次浏览的档位中，Starter、Growth、Business 分别显示 $9、$14、$19/月。费用随浏览量和功能变化；年付另选，各方案提供 30 天试用。

summary.en: Up to 10k pageviews/month: Starter $9, Growth $14, Business $19/month; annual billing separate.
summary.zh: 每月 1 万浏览档：Starter $9、Growth $14、Business $19/月；年付另选。

description.en: Visits without referrer information may appear as Direct / None. The hosted service uses paid subscriptions after a limited trial.
description.zh: 缺少来源信息的访问可能显示为 Direct / None；托管服务在限时试用后需付费订阅。

summary.en: Missing referrers can appear as Direct/None; hosted service is paid after trial.
summary.zh: 缺失来源可能归入直接访问；托管版试用后付费。

description.en: Select by pageview volume and reporting needs: Business adds funnels and revenue analysis beyond simpler traffic reports. This measures recognized referral visits, rather than a prompt-monitoring tool's brand mentions.
description.zh: 按浏览量和报表需求选档：Business 在基础流量报表外增加漏斗与收入分析。它衡量已识别的引荐访问，与提示词监测工具的品牌提及是不同指标。

description.en: See which AI chatbots send visitors to your verified website.
description.zh: 查看哪些 AI 聊天工具为已验证的网站带来访问。

en: Measure referral visits from AI chatbots including ChatGPT, Perplexity and Gemini, alongside landing pages and custom events.
Use cookie-free aggregate analytics; daily visitor identifiers do not track the same person across days.
zh: 衡量 ChatGPT、Perplexity 和 Gemini 等 AI 聊天工具带来的引荐访问，并查看落地页和自定义事件。
使用无 Cookie 的汇总分析；每日访客标识不会跨日追踪同一人。

audience.en: Website owners starting with free AI referral measurement and upgrading as traffic grows.
audience.zh: 希望从免费 AI 引荐统计开始、随流量增长扩容的网站所有者。

description.en: When checking what people do after an AI referral, examine landing pages and custom events in human-visit analytics, separately from bot requests.
description.zh: 检查 AI 引荐访客的后续行为时，通过真人访问分析查看落地页与自定义事件，并与机器人请求分开解读。

summary.en: Analyze human AI referrals, landing pages and events.
summary.zh: 分析真人 AI 引荐、落地页及事件。

label.zh: Ahrefs Web Analytics 官方产品功能

label.zh: Ahrefs Web Analytics 数据收集、免费额度与付费扩容

description.en: The official help page lists a free allowance of one million events/month per project. Paid event capacity is USD 99/month for five million, USD 299 for twenty million and USD 999 for one hundred million; local currency displays may differ.
description.zh: 官方帮助页列出每个项目每月 100 万事件的免费额度；付费扩容为 500 万事件 99 美元/月、2,000 万 299 美元/月、1 亿 999 美元/月，地区币种显示可能不同。

summary.en: Free: 1M events/project/month; 5M events: USD 99/month.
summary.zh: 每项目每月 100 万事件免费；500 万事件为 99 美元/月。

description.en: A continuing free allowance is available per project, with paid Web Analytics add-ons for higher event volumes; this measures human visits separately from Bot Analytics.
description.zh: 每个项目有持续免费额度，较高事件量需购买 Web Analytics 扩容；真人访问统计与 Bot Analytics 分开。

summary.en: Higher event volume costs extra; bot requests use separate analytics.
summary.zh: 超额事件需付费扩容；爬虫请求另行统计。

description.en: For human AI referrals, use Web Analytics and its event allowance; for server-side automated requests, compare the separate Bot Analytics product. Neither dataset substitutes for recorded answer citations.
description.zh: 衡量真人 AI 引荐时使用 Web Analytics 及其事件额度；研究服务器端自动请求时比较独立的 Bot Analytics。两类数据都不能代替已记录的回答引用。

description.en: Track location-level visibility in AI answers alongside local map rankings.
description.zh: 跟踪门店在 AI 回答中的曝光，并对照本地地图排名。

en: Measure local business visibility across supported AI search platforms.
Compare AI visibility with traditional map rankings and local competitors.
zh: 衡量本地企业在支持的 AI 搜索平台中的曝光。
对照传统地图排名与本地竞品表现。

audience.en: Local businesses, multi-location brands and local SEO agencies.
audience.zh: 本地企业、连锁品牌及本地 SEO 代理机构。

description.en: When assessing a local business, compare AI recommendation visibility with local competitors and review map rankings as a separate discovery measure.
description.zh: 评估本地商家表现时，对比 AI 推荐曝光与当地竞品，并将地图排名作为另一项发现渠道指标单独查看。

summary.en: Compare local AI recommendations and map visibility separately.
summary.zh: 分别比较本地 AI 推荐与地图曝光。

description.zh: Starter、Basic、Pro、Premium 月付分别为 $24.99、$49.99、$99.99、$199.99，含 7,500、15,150、31,250、63,150 积分。这些是共享扫描积分，不代表无限 AI 监测。

summary.en: Starter: $24.99/month, 7,500 shared scan credits; higher tiers available.
summary.zh: Starter $24.99/月，7,500 共享扫描积分；可选更高档。

description.en: AI scans use Share of AI Voice (SAIV), separately from map-ranking metrics; scanning uses credits and signup credits are introductory.
description.zh: AI 扫描使用 AI 声量份额（SAIV），与地图排名指标分开；扫描消耗积分，注册赠送积分属于初始体验。

summary.en: AI scans consume credits; map rankings and AI voice share are different metrics.
summary.zh: AI 扫描消耗积分；地图排名与 AI 声量份额是不同指标。

description.en: Use AI share of voice to assess AI recommendations and map grids to assess map visibility. Size the credit budget for the actual AI scans instead of comparing the subscription price alone.
description.zh: 用 AI 声量份额评估 AI 推荐，用地图网格评估地图曝光。应按实际 AI 扫描配置估算积分，而非只比较订阅价格。

description.en: Understand how your locations appear in AI and traditional search.
description.zh: 了解各门店在 AI 搜索与传统搜索中的表现。

en: Analyze brand discoverability and local competitor performance in AI and Google search.
Explore brand sentiment and recommendations to improve visibility.
Trace the websites and content sources cited when AI platforms mention your brand.
zh: 分析品牌在 AI 和 Google 搜索中的可发现性及本地竞品表现。
查看品牌情绪与曝光改进建议。
追踪 AI 平台提及品牌时引用的网站与内容来源。

audience.en: Location-based brands comparing local discovery across search channels.
audience.zh: 需要跨搜索渠道对比本地发现表现的门店品牌。

description.en: When reviewing visibility for a location-based brand, compare local competitors and investigate the websites cited when AI answers mention the brand.
description.zh: 复盘本地品牌曝光时，对比当地竞品，并调查 AI 回答提及品牌时引用的网站。

summary.en: Review local competitors and AI-cited websites.
summary.zh: 复盘本地竞品与 AI 被引网站。

label.zh: Yext 定制计费与 Scout 购买方式

description.zh: Scout 可单独购买或与其他 Yext 服务组合。官方 FAQ 说明价格取决于门店数量、方案和合同期限，没有统一公开的每门店固定报价。

summary.en: Custom quote by locations, package and contract term.
summary.zh: 按门店数、方案和合同期限询价。

description.en: Scout is sold standalone or in a custom solution; pricing depends on scope, locations and contract terms.
description.zh: Scout 可单独购买或纳入定制方案；价格取决于范围、门店数量与合同条款。

summary.en: Scope and location count are contract-defined; standalone or bundled purchase.
summary.zh: 可单购或组合采购；范围、门店数以合同为准。

description.en: Its procurement and workflow are oriented around brand and location coverage. Compare the quoted store count, contract and cited-source analysis instead of assuming a universal self-service price per store.
description.zh: 其采购和工作流围绕品牌与门店覆盖展开。应比较报价中的门店数、合同及引用来源分析，不应假设存在统一自助每门店价格。

description.en: Measure brand visibility, research prompts and compare competitors in AI answers.
description.zh: 衡量品牌在 AI 回答中的曝光，研究提示词并比较竞品。

en: Compare brand mentions and sentiment with competitors, and identify visibility gaps.
Track selected prompts daily and audit technical issues that may affect AI crawler access.
zh: 比较品牌与竞品的提及和情绪，识别曝光缺口。
每日跟踪指定提示词，并诊断可能影响 AI 爬虫访问的技术问题。

audience.en: SEO and marketing teams combining AI visibility research with an ongoing search workflow.
audience.zh: 需要将 AI 曝光研究纳入日常搜索工作流的 SEO 与营销团队。

description.en: When planning a brand visibility review, compare competitor mentions and sentiment to identify questions where your brand has less exposure.
description.zh: 规划品牌曝光复盘时，比较竞品提及与情绪，找出自有品牌曝光较少的问题。

summary.en: Find competitor mention and sentiment gaps.
summary.zh: 查找竞品提及及情绪差异。

description.en: When reviewing a monitoring gap, track selected prompts and examine technical audit findings for issues that may affect AI crawler access.
description.zh: 复查监测缺口时，持续跟踪选定提示词，并检查技术诊断中可能影响 AI 爬虫访问的问题。

summary.en: Track prompts and audit AI crawler access.
summary.zh: 追踪提示词并诊断 AI 爬虫访问。

description.en: Base is listed at $99/month per domain, billed annually. It includes daily tracking of 25 custom prompts and Brand Performance analysis for one domain. This is the annual commitment's monthly rate, not a verified month-to-month price.
description.zh: Base 标价每域名折算 $99/月，按年结算；含 25 个自定义提示词的每日追踪及 1 个域名的品牌表现分析。这是年付承诺下的月度折算价，不是已核实的逐月付款价。

summary.en: Base: $99/domain/month billed annually; 25 daily prompts, one domain.
summary.zh: Base 每域名年付折算 $99/月，25 个每日提示词、1 个域名。

description.en: Prompt tracking, brand-performance reports and site audits have different refresh schedules and limits; standalone toolkit access is paid.
description.zh: 提示词监控、品牌表现报告与网站诊断的刷新频率和额度不同；独立工具集需要付费。

summary.en: Prompt, brand-report and audit quotas and refresh rates differ.
summary.zh: 提示词、品牌报表及诊断的额度和刷新频率不同。

description.en: The Base offer is billed annually per domain and includes 25 daily custom prompts; Peec's Starter is a monthly brand plan with 50 prompts. Normalize billing term, domains and engine mix before comparing the headline amounts.
description.zh: Base 按域名年付，含每日 25 个自定义提示词；Peec Starter 是含 50 个提示词的品牌月付方案。比较表面金额前，应统一账期、域名范围与引擎组合。

description.en: Track linked and unlinked brand mentions and examine the sources behind AI answers.
description.zh: 跟踪带链接及不带链接的品牌提及，分析 AI 回答背后的引用来源。

en: Inspect cited domains, URLs and prompt-level answers across supported AI platforms.
Compare competitor visibility and organize source coverage by market and language.
zh: 查看支持平台上的引用域名、URL 与提示词级回答。
比较竞品曝光，并按市场和语言研究来源覆盖。

audience.en: SEO teams and agencies investigating which pages and domains influence AI answers.
audience.zh: 需要研究哪些页面和域名影响 AI 回答的 SEO 团队与代理机构。

description.en: When researching citation coverage in a market or language, inspect cited domains and URLs and return to the cached prompt-level answers for context.
description.zh: 研究某个市场或语言的引用覆盖时，查看被引域名与 URL，并回看提示词对应的缓存回答以了解上下文。

summary.en: Inspect cited URLs and cached answers by market or language.
summary.zh: 按市场或语言查看引用 URL 与缓存回答。

description.en: When comparing competitors, group citation sources to investigate which types of websites appear in their AI answers.
description.zh: 比较竞品时，对引用来源分类，调查竞品相关 AI 回答中出现了哪些类型的网站。

summary.en: Classify citation sources around competitors.
summary.zh: 分类研究竞品相关引用来源。

Ahrefs Brand Radar 选型比较依据

description.en: The current subscription page separates Core and Growth bundles from an AI Search add-on with 200 prompts. Prices are localized; the observed ¥ display did not clearly identify the settlement currency, so no converted or assumed USD/CNY amount is quoted here.
description.zh: 当前订阅页将 Core、Growth 组合方案与含 200 个提示词的 AI Search 加购项分开。价格会本地化，本次 ¥ 显示未明确结算币种，因此不在此推定美元或人民币金额，也不作换算。

summary.en: Core/Growth bundles plus a 200-prompt AI Search add-on; localized amount unconfirmed.
summary.zh: Core／Growth 组合及 200 提示词 AI Search 加购；地区币种金额待确认。

description.en: Classify citation sources and review cached AI answers; API and MCP access are separate integration capabilities rather than additional monitored engines.
description.zh: 对引用来源分类并回看缓存的 AI 回答；API 与 MCP 是数据集成能力，不是额外的监测平台。

summary.en: API/MCP are integrations, not extra monitoring engines.
summary.zh: API／MCP 是集成方式，不是额外监测引擎。

description.en: For prompt-level citation investigation, compare cached answers and market/language filters. Ahrefs Brand Radar also offers a pre-collected index for exploratory research, so first decide whether the task is a defined question set or broader market exploration.
description.zh: 提示词级引用调查可比较缓存回答及市场／语言筛选；Ahrefs Brand Radar 另提供预采集索引用于探索研究。应先明确任务是固定问题集合，还是更广的市场探索。

description.en: Monitor recurring business prompts and connect AI answers with citations and crawler activity.
description.zh: 持续监测业务提示词，关联 AI 回答、引用与爬虫活动。

en: Track brand visibility and share of voice for selected prompts across AI platforms.
Review cited sources and use crawler logs and content-gap analysis to guide follow-up work.
zh: 在多个 AI 平台上跟踪指定提示词下的品牌曝光与声量份额。
查看引用来源，结合爬虫日志和内容缺口分析安排后续工作。

audience.en: Marketing teams and agencies maintaining repeatable prompt monitoring and reporting.
audience.zh: 需要持续开展提示词监测和报告的营销团队与代理机构。

description.en: When planning follow-up content work, review prompt-level visibility together with cited sources, crawler logs and content gaps.
description.zh: 安排后续内容工作时，结合提示词级曝光、被引来源、爬虫日志和内容缺口确定复查重点。

summary.en: Plan content work using citations, logs and visibility gaps.
summary.zh: 结合引用、日志及曝光缺口安排内容工作。

label.zh: Promptwatch 监控与分析功能
Promptwatch 方案与平台覆盖

description.en: The monthly pricing display lists Essential at $95, Professional at $245 and Business at $579, with one, two and five projects respectively. Prompt allowances and account scope vary by plan.
description.zh: 月付定价显示 Essential $95、Professional $245、Business $579，分别含 1、2、5 个项目；提示词额度及账户范围随套餐变化。

summary.en: Monthly Essential $95/one project; Professional $245/two; Business $579/five.
summary.zh: Essential 月付 $95/1 项目；Professional $245/2 项目；Business $579/5 项目。

description.en: A brand mention, an answer citation and a crawler request measure different events; review each metric's definition before combining them in a report.
description.zh: 品牌提及、回答引用和爬虫请求衡量不同事件，合并到报告前需分别核对指标定义。

summary.en: Mentions, answer citations and crawler requests are distinct metrics.
summary.zh: 提及、回答引用和爬虫请求需分开解读。

description.en: Compare its combined prompt, citation, crawler-log and content-gap workflow against tools limited to one of those datasets. Check project and prompt allowances for each client rather than assuming one project covers an agency portfolio.
description.zh: 可将其结合提示词、引用、爬虫日志和内容缺口的流程，与只处理其中一类数据的工具比较。需逐客户核对项目和提示词额度，不假设单项目覆盖全部代理业务。

description.en: Compare brands in AI answers using indexed responses and custom prompt tracking.
description.zh: 结合回答索引与自定义提示词监测，比较品牌在 AI 回答中的表现。

en: Compare brand mentions, citation share and the pages or domains cited by AI engines.
Research existing AI response indexes or schedule checks for your own prompts; Claude is available through custom prompts.
zh: 比较品牌提及、引用份额以及 AI 平台引用的页面和域名。
研究现有 AI 回答索引，或为自定义提示词安排检查；Claude 通过自定义提示词提供。

audience.en: SEO and brand teams comparing their AI presence with competitors and investigating citation gaps.
audience.zh: 需要比较品牌与竞品 AI 表现并研究引用缺口的 SEO 与品牌团队。

description.en: When exploring a market, search the existing AI answer index to compare brand mentions and investigate the domains and pages cited around competitors.
description.zh: 探索市场时，检索已有 AI 回答索引，比较品牌提及，并调查竞品相关回答引用的域名和页面。

summary.en: Research markets using the pre-collected AI answer index.
summary.zh: 用预采集 AI 回答索引研究市场。

description.en: For business-specific buying questions, schedule custom prompt checks and keep their results separate from the pre-collected answer index.
description.zh: 针对业务特有的购买问题，安排自定义提示词检查，并将结果与预采集回答索引分开解读。

summary.en: Run custom checks for business-specific questions.
summary.zh: 持续检查业务特有的自定义问题。

label.zh: Ahrefs Brand Radar 产品资料

label.en: Brand Radar coverage, methodology and pricing
label.zh: Brand Radar 覆盖、方法与定价

description.en: The official product page displays Custom Prompts from €47/month and the AI Visibility Index from €179/month. It also states that Custom Prompts is included with paid Ahrefs Lite and higher plans. These are different purchase paths, not one combined bundle price.
description.zh: 官方产品页显示 Custom Prompts 从 €47/月起，AI Visibility Index 从 €179/月起；另说明付费 Ahrefs Lite 及以上方案包含 Custom Prompts。这些是不同购买入口，不能相加或当作同一个全包价格。

summary.en: Custom Prompts from €47/month; AI index from €179/month. Paid Lite+ includes Custom Prompts.
summary.zh: Custom Prompts 从 €47/月起；AI 索引从 €179/月起。付费 Lite 及以上含 Custom Prompts。

description.en: The pre-collected AI index and custom prompts use different refresh schedules; the help center reports that new Grok data collection is temporarily unavailable.
description.zh: 预先采集的 AI 索引与自定义提示词采用不同刷新频率；帮助中心说明 Grok 新数据采集暂不可用。

summary.en: Index and custom prompts refresh differently; new Grok collection is unavailable.
summary.zh: 索引与自定义提示词刷新频率不同；Grok 暂停新数据采集。

description.en: Choose between researching the pre-collected AI Visibility Index and running Custom Prompts for a defined question set. Their refresh schedules and purchase paths differ, so keep them separate in a vendor comparison.
description.zh: 应区分用 AI Visibility Index 研究预采集回答，还是用 Custom Prompts 追踪固定问题。两者刷新频率和购买入口不同，进行厂商比较时需分开计算。

description.en: Get a free snapshot of how AI models describe and position your brand.
description.zh: 免费查看 AI 模型如何描述和定位你的品牌。

en: Request a free, one-time brand perception report across sentiment, presence quality, recognition, share of voice and market position.
The official page describes responses based on model training data across ChatGPT, Perplexity and Gemini; this is a snapshot rather than continuous prompt monitoring.
zh: 获取一次免费的品牌认知报告，覆盖情绪、呈现质量、品牌认知、声量份额和市场定位。
官方说明依据 ChatGPT、Perplexity 和 Gemini 的模型训练数据作答；结果是一次快照，不是持续提示词监测。

audience.en: Brand and marketing teams looking for an initial AI perception snapshot.
audience.zh: 希望初步了解 AI 品牌认知的品牌与营销团队。

description.en: Before setting up ongoing monitoring, use a one-time brand perception report as an initial snapshot of sentiment and positioning, rather than a historical trend.
description.zh: 建立持续监测前，先用一次性品牌认知报告了解情绪与定位快照，不将它当作历史趋势。

summary.en: Get an initial brand-perception snapshot.
summary.zh: 获取品牌认知初始快照。

label.en: HubSpot AI Search Grader scope and free diagnostic
label.zh: HubSpot AI Search Grader 范围与免费诊断
HubSpot AEO 选型比较依据

description.en: AI Search Grader is a free, one-time brand diagnostic. Continuing monitoring is the separate HubSpot AEO product, advertised at $50/month; that price is not a charge for the Grader snapshot.
description.zh: AI Search Grader 是免费的一次性品牌诊断。持续监测由独立的 HubSpot AEO 提供，标价 $50/月；该金额不是 Grader 快照的收费。

summary.en: Free, one-time diagnostic; ongoing AEO monitoring is a separate product.
summary.zh: 免费的一次性诊断；持续 AEO 监测另购。

description.en: The initial check needs no account; a form provides access to the full report. Ongoing monitoring is offered by the separate paid HubSpot AEO product.
description.zh: 初始检查无需账户，完整报告通过表单获取；持续监测由独立的付费 HubSpot AEO 产品提供。

summary.en: Full report requires a form; no continuing prompt monitoring.
summary.zh: 完整报告需填表；不提供持续提示词监测。

description.en: Choose Grader for a free one-time perception snapshot, or compare HubSpot AEO for recurring prompt tracking at $50/month. Re-running isolated snapshots does not turn Grader into the AEO monitoring subscription.
description.zh: 需要免费的一次性认知快照时选择 Grader；需要持续提示词追踪时比较 $50/月的 HubSpot AEO。重复运行独立快照不等于购买 AEO 持续监测订阅。

description.en: Use AI search insights to plan, create and refresh brand content.
description.zh: 结合 AI 搜索洞察规划、生产和更新品牌内容。

en: Combine brand knowledge, agents and review workflows to research, publish and refresh content.
Connect content production with competitor insights and AI search visibility; Solo lists ChatGPT-only insights, while Pro lists broader answer-engine coverage.
zh: 结合品牌知识、Agent 和审核工作流，研究、发布并更新内容。
关联内容生产、竞品洞察与 AI 搜索曝光；Solo 列出仅限 ChatGPT 的洞察，Pro 列出更广的回答引擎覆盖。

audience.en: Content and growth teams managing repeatable content workflows for AI discovery.
audience.zh: 需要为 AI 发现建立持续内容工作流的内容与增长团队。

description.en: When organizing content production, use brand knowledge and review workflows to coordinate research, drafting, publication and later updates.
description.zh: 组织内容生产时，结合品牌知识与审核工作流，衔接研究、草稿、发布和后续更新。

summary.en: Coordinate brand-aware content research, review and publishing.
summary.zh: 衔接品牌内容研究、审核与发布。

label.en: AirOps AI discovery and content workflows
label.zh: AirOps AI 发现与内容工作流
AirOps 方案与按任务计费说明

description.en: The pricing FAQ describes task-based usage and Solo overage at $0.025 per task. A consistent recurring base-plan price was not verified; the 14-day trial and overage rate do not establish a continuing free plan or total subscription cost.
description.zh: 定价 FAQ 说明按任务用量计费，Solo 超额任务为每次 $0.025。本轮未核实一致的基础订阅价；14 天试用和超额单价不能代表长期免费方案或完整订阅费用。

summary.en: Base price unconfirmed; Solo overage $0.025/task. Trial is not a recurring free plan.
summary.zh: 基础订阅价待确认；Solo 超额 $0.025/任务。试用不等于长期免费。

description.en: The pricing page describes task-based billing and an introductory trial, but does not clearly establish an ongoing free tier or a consistent current plan structure.
description.zh: 计费页介绍按任务计费及初始试用，但未明确持续免费档，当前方案结构的说明也不完全一致。

summary.en: Task-based billing; recurring free tier and plan boundaries remain unclear.
summary.zh: 按任务计费；持续免费档及方案边界尚不明确。

description.en: Evaluate the task budget for the full research-to-publication workflow, including model calls and review steps. Compare its content operations separately from a product sold only as a prompt-monitoring allowance.
description.zh: 应按完整的研究至发布流程估算任务预算，包括模型调用和审核步骤。其内容运营能力应与仅按提示词额度出售的监测工具分开比较。

description.en: Research, write and optimize content while monitoring its visibility in AI search.
description.zh: 研究、撰写和优化内容，同时监测其在 AI 搜索中的曝光。

en: Create content briefs and drafts, then use SEO and GEO scoring to identify coverage gaps.
Combine site audits and content updates with brand citation monitoring; AI engine coverage varies by plan.
zh: 制作内容简报与草稿，使用 SEO 和 GEO 评分识别信息覆盖缺口。
结合网站诊断、内容更新与品牌引用监测；AI 平台覆盖随方案变化。

audience.en: Content teams and agencies managing research, optimization and AI visibility in one workflow.
audience.zh: 希望在同一流程中完成研究、优化和 AI 曝光监测的内容团队与代理机构。

description.en: When preparing or refreshing an article, use a brief, draft and SEO/GEO coverage checks to identify information that needs editorial review.
description.zh: 准备或更新文章时，通过内容简报、草稿与 SEO／GEO 覆盖检查，找出需要编辑复核的信息。

summary.en: Create briefs and review SEO/GEO information gaps.
summary.zh: 制作内容简报，复查 SEO／GEO 信息缺口。

label.en: Frase content and AI search features
label.zh: Frase 内容与 AI 搜索功能
Frase 定价与方案限制

description.en: Starter is $49/month or $39/month billed yearly; Professional is $129/month or $103/month billed yearly; Scale is $299/month or $239/month billed yearly. These are content/GEO subscriptions, separate from the free FraseCMS hosting offer.
description.zh: Starter 月付 $49，年付折算 $39/月；Professional 月付 $129，年付折算 $103/月；Scale 月付 $299，年付折算 $239/月。这些是内容／GEO 订阅，与免费的 FraseCMS 托管方案分开。

summary.en: Starter $49/month or $39/month billed yearly; Professional $129 or $103 yearly-rate/month.
summary.zh: Starter 月付 $49、年付折算 $39/月；Professional 月付 $129、年付折算 $103/月。

description.en: The free Answers widget is separate from paid GEO content and AI visibility plans.
description.zh: 免费的 Answers 问答组件与付费 GEO 内容及 AI 曝光方案分开提供。

summary.en: Free Answers component is separate from paid GEO content and monitoring.
summary.zh: 免费 Answers 组件与付费 GEO 内容及监测分开。

description.en: Select by sites, seats and content capacity as well as AI engines: Starter, Professional and Scale expose different tracking coverage. Free CMS hosting is not the paid content/GEO workflow.
description.zh: 选档除比较 AI 引擎外，还需比较网站数、席位和内容容量；Starter、Professional、Scale 的监测覆盖不同。免费 CMS 托管不等于付费内容／GEO 工作流。

description.en: Analyze AI crawler requests and manage how AI services access your website.
description.zh: 分析 AI 爬虫请求，管理 AI 服务对网站的访问。

en: Inspect AI crawler requests by operator, hostname, path and response status on domains whose traffic is proxied through Cloudflare.
Allow or block individual AI crawlers. Free-plan detection uses user-agent strings and its detailed metrics cover the past 24 hours.
zh: 在通过 Cloudflare 代理流量的域名上，按运营方、主机名、路径和响应状态检查 AI 爬虫请求。
允许或拦截单个 AI 爬虫；免费方案依赖 user-agent 字符串识别，详细指标覆盖过去 24 小时。

audience.en: Website operators and publishers measuring AI crawler access to their content.
audience.zh: 需要衡量 AI 爬虫内容访问情况的网站运营者与出版方。

description.en: For a site proxied through Cloudflare, inspect AI crawler requests by path and response status before choosing which crawlers to allow or block.
description.zh: 对于通过 Cloudflare 代理的网站，先按路径和响应状态检查 AI 爬虫请求，再决定允许或拦截哪些爬虫。

summary.en: Inspect crawler requests before allowing or blocking bots.
summary.zh: 检查爬虫请求，决定允许或拦截。

label.zh: Cloudflare AI Crawl Control 概述
Cloudflare 配置与免费方案限制

description.en: AI Crawl Control is available on Cloudflare's free plan for proxied domains. Enterprise Bot Management adds identification and analytics capabilities; infrastructure and other Cloudflare services are not thereby all free.
description.zh: AI Crawl Control 可用于 Cloudflare 免费方案下的代理域名；Enterprise Bot Management 提供额外识别和分析能力。这不代表基础设施及其他 Cloudflare 服务全部免费。

summary.en: Available on the free plan for proxied domains; Enterprise capabilities cost separately.
summary.zh: 代理域名可用免费方案；Enterprise 能力另计。

description.en: Enterprise Bot Management enables additional detection and configurable analytics windows; crawler requests are distinct from human referrals or confirmed answer citations.
description.zh: Enterprise Bot Management 提供额外识别能力和可配置分析时间窗；爬虫请求不同于真人引荐或已确认的回答引用。

summary.en: Enterprise identification/windows differ; crawling does not prove citations or visits.
summary.zh: 企业识别及时间窗不同；抓取不证明引用或真人访问。

description.en: Choose it to inspect or control crawler access on a proxied domain. It does not replace answer sampling or human-referral analytics, and Enterprise bot identification should be assessed separately from the free user-agent-based view.
description.zh: 它适合检查或控制代理域名的爬虫访问，不能替代回答采样或真人引荐分析；Enterprise 的机器人识别也应与免费方案的 user-agent 视图分开评估。

description.en: Measure AI recommendations for each business location and compare local competitors.
description.zh: 衡量各门店获得 AI 推荐的情况，并与本地竞品比较。

en: Track location-level visibility and prompt results across ChatGPT, Google AI Mode and Google AI Overviews.
Compare local competitors and cited sources, distinguishing named business mentions from source citations.
zh: 跟踪门店在 ChatGPT、Google AI Mode 和 Google AI Overviews 中的曝光及提示词结果。
比较本地竞品与被引来源，并区分商家名称提及与来源引用。

audience.en: Local businesses, multi-location teams and agencies managing location-level AI search visibility.
audience.zh: 需要管理门店级 AI 搜索曝光的本地企业、连锁团队与代理机构。

description.en: For a store-level visibility review, compare local competitors on selected questions and distinguish a business-name mention from a cited source.
description.zh: 复盘单个门店的曝光时，在选定问题上比较当地竞品，并区分商家名称提及和来源引用。

summary.en: Compare store mentions, citations and local competitors.
summary.zh: 比较门店提及、引用和本地竞品。

label.zh: BrightLocal 本地 AI 曝光功能
BrightLocal 定价与包含工具

description.en: For one location, Track is USD 41/month paid monthly or USD 369/year (displayed as about USD 31/month). Manage is USD 54/month and Grow USD 65/month on monthly billing. Local AI Visibility is included; multi-location tiers cost differently.
description.zh: 1 个门店时，Track 月付 41 美元，或年付 369 美元（页面折算约 31 美元/月）；Manage 月付 54 美元，Grow 月付 65 美元。包含 Local AI Visibility，多门店另按档位计费。

summary.en: One location: Track USD 41/month or USD 369/year; Manage 54, Grow 65 monthly.
summary.zh: 1 门店：Track 月付 41 美元或年付 369 美元；Manage 月付 54、Grow 65 美元。

description.en: The current product allows up to 20 editable prompts per location and is included in the Track, Manage and Grow subscriptions; free access is a limited trial.
description.zh: 当前每个门店最多设置 20 个可编辑提示词，功能包含在 Track、Manage 和 Grow 订阅中；免费入口为限时试用。

summary.en: Up to 20 editable prompts/location; included in Track/Manage/Grow. Trial only.
summary.zh: 每门店最多 20 个可编辑提示词；三档均包含，免费仅限试用。

description.en: All three subscription families include Local AI Visibility; choose Manage or Grow for their broader listings or reputation workflows, rather than assuming a higher plan is required just to start AI tracking.
description.zh: 三类订阅均包含 Local AI Visibility。选择 Manage 或 Grow 应基于更广的商家信息或声誉工作流，不应以为开始 AI 追踪就必须升至更高档。

description.en: See how your website pages are cited in Microsoft AI answers.
description.zh: 查看网站页面在微软 AI 回答中被引用的情况。

en: Review citation counts, cited URLs and citation trends across Microsoft Copilot and AI-generated summaries in Bing.
Inspect sampled grounding queries used to retrieve cited content; citation counts do not measure answer position or referral visits.
zh: 查看 Microsoft Copilot 和 Bing AI 摘要中的引用次数、被引 URL 与引用趋势。
查看用于检索被引内容的查询样本；引用次数不衡量回答中的位置或引荐访问。

audience.en: Website owners and publishers investigating citations of their own content in Microsoft AI experiences.
audience.zh: 希望研究自身内容在微软 AI 产品中被引用情况的网站所有者与出版方。

description.en: When checking which pages Microsoft AI experiences cite, review citation trends and retrieval query samples; these counts do not measure referral visits.
description.zh: 检查 Microsoft AI 体验引用哪些页面时，查看引用趋势和检索查询样本；这些次数不代表引荐访问量。

summary.en: Review Microsoft AI citations and retrieval query samples.
summary.zh: 查看 Microsoft AI 引用与检索查询样本。

label.en: Bing Webmaster Tools official product and free access
label.zh: Bing Webmaster Tools 官方产品与免费使用

label.en: Bing official AI Performance announcement and metrics
label.zh: Bing 官方 AI Performance 公告与指标说明

description.en: Free within Bing Webmaster Tools; the public reporting scope covers Microsoft AI citations rather than a separate commercial monitoring subscription.
description.zh: 作为 Bing Webmaster Tools 功能免费提供；公开报表范围是 Microsoft AI 引用，而不是独立商业监测订阅。

summary.en: Free within Bing Webmaster Tools.
summary.zh: 随 Bing Webmaster Tools 免费提供。

description.en: Citation counts do not measure a link's placement or referral visits. The grounding-query report is a sample, not a complete list of every user question.
description.zh: 引用次数不衡量链接在回答中的位置或引荐访问；检索查询报告是样本，不是全部用户问题清单。

summary.en: No answer-position or referral metric; queries are sampled.
summary.zh: 不提供回答位置或引荐指标；查询仅为样本。

description.en: Use this to review Microsoft-platform citation telemetry for your own content. Compare it with custom-prompt tools only after accounting for the different platform coverage and the absence of referral or answer-position metrics.
description.zh: 它适合查看自有内容在 Microsoft 平台中的引用遥测。与自定义提示词工具比较时，需先考虑平台范围差异，以及它不提供引荐访问或回答位置指标的边界。

description.en: Collect AI answers and cited sources through an API, with scheduled brand monitoring.
description.zh: 通过 API 采集 AI 回答与引用来源，并定期监测品牌表现。

en: Return AI answers, citation URLs and search queries as structured data for GEO analysis.
Schedule prompts by engine and country, then inspect brand mentions, cited domains and competitor share of voice.
zh: 将 AI 回答、引用 URL 与检索查询整理为结构化数据，用于 GEO 分析。
按引擎与国家定期运行提示词，查看品牌提及、被引域名和竞品声量占比。

audience.en: Developers and agencies building citation analysis or multi-brand GEO reporting.
audience.zh: 开发引用分析工具或多品牌 GEO 报告的开发者与代理机构。

description.en: When building a GEO research dataset, collect answers, citation URLs and retrieval queries, then compare recurring prompts by engine and country.
description.zh: 构建 GEO 研究数据集时，整理回答、引用 URL 与检索查询，再按引擎和国家比较定期运行的提示词。

summary.en: Collect structured answers, citation URLs and retrieval queries.
summary.zh: 采集结构化回答、引用 URL 和检索查询。

label.en: querying.ai official API and engine capabilities
label.zh: querying.ai 官方 API 与引擎能力

label.en: querying.ai scheduled monitoring and citation metrics
label.zh: querying.ai 定期监测与引用指标
querying.ai 订阅方案与积分

description.en: Basic is USD 20/month for 8,000 credits; Pro USD 200 for 170,000; Scale USD 500 for 480,000; Max USD 1,000 for one million. Credits per request depend on the engine.
description.zh: Basic 为 20 美元/月，含 8,000 积分；Pro 为 200 美元、170,000 积分；Scale 为 500 美元、480,000 积分；Max 为 1,000 美元、100 万积分。单次请求消耗随引擎变化。

summary.en: Basic USD 20/month/8,000 credits; Pro USD 200/170,000. Engine costs vary.
summary.zh: Basic 20 美元/月/8,000 积分；Pro 200 美元/170,000 积分。引擎单价不同。

description.en: Subscriptions use task credits; introductory free credits do not renew as a free plan.
description.zh: 订阅按任务积分计费；初始赠送积分不代表持续免费方案。

summary.en: Requests consume credits; initial credits do not recur.
summary.zh: 请求消耗积分；初始赠送额度不续充。

description.en: Its structured answer and retrieval-query output suits data collection and analysis pipelines. Compare request-credit costs by engine; the same prompt count can consume different credits on different models.
description.zh: 结构化回答与检索查询输出适合数据采集和分析流程。需按引擎比较单请求积分，同样的提示词数量在不同模型上可能消耗不同积分。

description.en: Schedule prompt tracking and examine what AI answers say about your brand.
description.zh: 定期追踪提示词，分析 AI 回答如何描述品牌。

en: Group prompts by topic and choose models and a weekly, every-two-days or daily tracking cadence.
Analyze brand mentions, citations, factual gaps and competitors, with topic reports and action plans.
zh: 按主题整理提示词，选择模型及每周、每两天或每日的追踪频率。
分析品牌提及、引用、事实缺口与竞品，生成主题报告与行动建议。

audience.en: Brand managers and agencies organizing recurring prompt and brand-knowledge reviews.
audience.zh: 需要定期复核提示词表现与品牌知识的品牌负责人和代理机构。

description.en: When organizing a topic review, group related prompts and use recurring checks to investigate brand mentions, factual gaps and competitor answers.
description.zh: 组织主题复盘时，将相关提示词分组，通过定期检查调查品牌提及、事实缺口和竞品回答。

summary.en: Group prompts to review brand facts and competitors.
summary.zh: 按主题复查品牌事实与竞品回答。

label.en: Waikay brand analysis and subscription plans
label.zh: Waikay 品牌分析与订阅方案

label.en: Waikay prompt cadence, model modes and credits
label.zh: Waikay 提示词频率、模型模式与积分
Waikay 不续充的初始免费积分

description.en: Level 1 is $24.95/month for eight credits; Level 2 $69.95 for thirty; Level 3 $199.95 for ninety. The free entry includes three introductory credits that do not renew; ongoing monitoring capacity depends on model mix and frequency.
description.zh: Level 1 为 $24.95/月、8 积分；Level 2 为 $69.95、30 积分；Level 3 为 $199.95、90 积分。免费入口的 3 个初始积分不续充，持续监测容量取决于模型组合和频率。

summary.en: $24.95/month/8 credits; free entry has three non-renewing credits.
summary.zh: $24.95/月/8 积分；免费入口的 3 积分不续充。

description.en: API and browser-based model modes have different credit costs; the initial free credits do not renew.
description.zh: API 与浏览器采样模式的积分消耗不同；初始免费积分不续充。

summary.en: API/browser sampling, models and frequency affect credits.
summary.zh: API／浏览器采样、模型与频率影响积分消耗。

description.en: Choose by the mix of reports and recurring tracking. A report uses a fixed credit, while prompt tracking varies with API versus browser sampling, model count and frequency.
description.zh: 应按报告与持续追踪的组合选型。报告使用固定积分，而提示词追踪会随 API 或浏览器采样方式、模型数量和频率变化。

description.en: Use citation and competitor insights to create and refine content for AI search.
description.zh: 结合引用与竞品洞察，创作和优化面向 AI 搜索的内容。

en: Identify content opportunities from sources cited for competitors and generate structured, question-driven drafts.
Set brand voice and editorial guidelines, then review, edit and export content for your publishing workflow.
zh: 从竞品的被引来源中发现内容机会，生成结构化、围绕问题展开的草稿。
设置品牌语气与编辑规范，再审核、修改并导出内容，用于现有发布流程。

audience.en: Content teams connecting AI citation research with editorial production and review.
audience.zh: 希望将 AI 引用研究接入内容生产和审核流程的团队。

description.en: When drafting content around a citation gap, review competitors' cited sources, apply brand voice and editorial rules, then edit the draft before export.
description.zh: 围绕引用缺口起草内容时，研究竞品被引来源，应用品牌语气与编辑规范，再审核并修改草稿后导出。

summary.en: Draft content from citation gaps, then review and export.
summary.zh: 围绕引用缺口起草、审核并导出内容。

label.en: Goodie Content Studio workflow and editorial controls
label.zh: Goodie Content Studio 工作流与编辑控制

label.en: Goodie plans and AI engine coverage
label.zh: Goodie 方案与 AI 平台覆盖

description.en: With annual billing indicated on the pricing page, Core is displayed at $295/month for 110 prompts and five core models, and Pro at $999/month for 250 prompts and eight models. Confirm the annual commitment before comparing with monthly subscriptions.
description.zh: 定价页标注年付，Core 显示折算 $295/月，含 110 个提示词和 5 个核心模型；Pro 为 $999/月，含 250 个提示词和 8 个模型。与月付订阅比较前需确认年度承诺。

summary.en: Annual rates: Core $295/month/110 prompts; Pro $999/250 prompts.
summary.zh: 年付折算：Core $295/月/110 个提示词；Pro $999/250 个。

description.en: Monitor AI mentions, citations and sentiment; engine coverage and action allowances vary by plan.
description.zh: 监测 AI 提及、引用和情绪；平台覆盖与操作额度随套餐变化。

summary.en: Model coverage and action allowances vary by plan.
summary.zh: 模型覆盖与操作额度随套餐变化。

description.en: Compare the complete research, brand-voice drafting and editorial-export workflow, not only prompt capacity. Draft generation still requires review before it is used in an existing publishing process.
description.zh: 应比较完整的研究、品牌语气草稿和编辑导出流程，而非只比较提示词容量。生成草稿仍需审核后才能用于现有发布流程。

description.en: Connect AI answer visibility with referral visits, landing pages and conversions.
description.zh: 关联 AI 回答曝光与引荐访问、落地页和转化表现。

en: Connect GA4 to inspect AI referral traffic, receiving pages, engagement and conversion trends.
Compare referral visits with tracked mentions and citations; assistants that omit referrers are not fully counted.
zh: 连接 GA4，查看 AI 引荐流量、接收页面、互动与转化趋势。
对照引荐访问与监测到的提及和引用；不传递来源信息的 AI 访问无法完整计入。

audience.en: Marketing and analytics teams measuring the visits and outcomes associated with AI search.
audience.zh: 需要衡量 AI 搜索带来的访问与业务结果的营销和分析团队。

description.en: For a site connected to GA4, compare AI-referred landing pages, engagement and conversions alongside monitored mentions; missing referrer data limits attribution.
description.zh: 网站接入 GA4 后，将 AI 引荐落地页、互动和转化与监测到的提及对照查看；缺少来源信息会限制归因。

summary.en: Connect GA4 to assess AI referrals and conversions.
summary.zh: 连接 GA4 分析 AI 引荐与转化。

label.en: Analyze AI referral analytics and measurement limits
label.zh: Analyze AI 引荐分析与测量限制

label.en: Analyze AI plans, GA4 integration and engine add-ons
label.zh: Analyze AI 方案、GA4 集成与平台加购

description.en: Growth is $99/month, with 25 daily tracked prompts and three engines; Pro is $250/month, with 35 daily prompts and four engines. Ad hoc checks are separate allowances of 50 and 100 per month.
description.zh: Growth 为 $99/月，含每日 25 个监测提示词和 3 个引擎；Pro 为 $250/月，含每日 35 个提示词和 4 个引擎。按需单次检查另有每月 50 次和 100 次额度。

summary.en: Growth $99/month: 25 daily prompts, three engines; Pro $250: 35 prompts, four engines.
summary.zh: Growth $99/月：25 个每日提示词、3 引擎；Pro $250：35 个、4 引擎。

description.en: Prompt tracking covers ChatGPT, Google AI Mode and Perplexity on Growth; additional engines depend on the plan or add-ons.
description.zh: Growth 的提示词监测包含 ChatGPT、Google AI Mode 与 Perplexity；其他平台取决于方案或加购。

summary.en: Growth covers ChatGPT, AI Mode, Perplexity; other engines depend on plan/add-ons.
summary.zh: Growth 含 ChatGPT、AI Mode、Perplexity；其他引擎按套餐或加购。

description.en: Choose it when GA4-based referral and conversion analysis is part of the task. Keep that traffic dataset separate from its prompt and citation monitoring; additional engines and ad hoc checks have their own limits.
description.zh: 任务包含基于 GA4 的引荐与转化分析时，可重点比较它。需将流量数据与提示词／引用监测分开解读，额外引擎和按需检查也有各自限制。

description.en: Benchmark brand visibility against competitors across AI search models.
description.zh: 跨 AI 搜索模型对比品牌与竞品的曝光表现。

en: Compare brand visibility with category competitors and investigate strengths and content gaps.
Use prompt research and repeated answer sampling to examine changing AI responses.
zh: 对比品牌与同品类竞品的曝光，调查优势与内容缺口。
结合提示词研究和重复回答采样，观察 AI 回答的变化。

audience.en: Brand and research teams comparing competitive positioning in AI answers.
audience.zh: 需要比较 AI 回答中竞争定位的品牌与研究团队。

description.en: When reviewing a product category, compare brand exposure with competing brands and use repeated answer samples to investigate changes and content gaps.
description.zh: 复盘产品品类时，对比品牌与同类竞品的曝光，通过重复回答样本调查变化和内容缺口。

summary.en: Investigate category visibility with repeated answer samples.
summary.zh: 通过重复回答样本研究品类曝光。

label.en: Evertune competitive visibility and prompt research
label.zh: Evertune 竞品曝光与提示词研究
Evertune 方案与采样限制

description.en: Starter is displayed at $60/month with 5,000 prompt credits. Pro is displayed at $800/month billed annually with 100,000 credits. Advertising-agent media fees are separate from monitoring subscription prices.
description.zh: Starter 显示 $60/月、5,000 提示词积分；Pro 显示按年结算折算 $800/月、100,000 积分。广告 Agent 的媒体费用与监测订阅费分开。

summary.en: Starter $60/month/5,000 credits; Pro $800/month billed annually/100,000 credits. Media fees separate.
summary.zh: Starter $60/月/5,000 积分；Pro 年付折算 $800/月/10 万积分。媒体费另计。

description.en: Model coverage and sampling depth vary by plan; high-volume sampling is listed for Pro and Enterprise.
description.zh: 模型覆盖与采样深度随方案变化；高频重复采样列于 Pro 和 Enterprise。

summary.en: Models and sampling depth vary; frequent repeat sampling is in Pro/Enterprise.
summary.zh: 模型和采样深度按档位区分；高频重复采样在 Pro／Enterprise。

description.en: Compare the required repeated-answer depth with included prompt credits. Starter and Pro have different credit budgets and billing terms, and advertising-agent media fees should not be folded into the monitoring price.
description.zh: 按所需重复回答采样深度比较提示词积分。Starter 与 Pro 的积分及账期不同，广告 Agent 媒体费用也不能混入监测订阅价。

description.en: Compare AI search visibility and cited sources for brands and individual locations.
description.zh: 对比品牌及各门店的 AI 搜索曝光与引用来源。

en: Switch between brand and location reporting to examine AI visibility trends, citations and competitor share of voice.
Filter reports by location, theme and selected AI sites; Google AI, Grok and Claude require enabling in report settings.
zh: 在品牌与门店视图间切换，查看 AI 曝光趋势、引用与竞品声量占比。
按门店、主题与 AI 平台筛选；Google AI、Grok 和 Claude 需在报告设置中启用。

audience.en: Multi-location businesses and agencies investigating local discovery in AI answers.
audience.zh: 需要研究 AI 回答中本地发现表现的多门店企业与代理机构。

description.en: For a multi-location review, switch between brand and store views and compare visibility, citations and competitors by location and topic.
description.zh: 开展多门店复盘时，在品牌与门店视图间切换，按位置和主题比较曝光、引用与竞品。

summary.en: Compare brand and store visibility by location/topic.
summary.zh: 按门店和主题比较品牌曝光。

label.zh: Birdeye 平台覆盖与门店报告设置

label.zh: Birdeye 按产品与门店配置报价

description.zh: 费用通过销售协议或定制方案确定。本轮未核实到该功能的固定公开金额，需在报价中确认监测范围、必要集成和合同期限。

summary.en: Custom quote; confirm monitoring, integrations and term.
summary.zh: 定制询价，确认监测范围、集成与合同期限。

description.en: Google AI, Grok and Claude must be enabled in the visibility report settings. Check the selected locations, topics and engines before comparing results.
description.zh: Google AI、Grok 和 Claude 需要在曝光报告设置中启用；对比结果前需核对所选门店、主题和引擎。

summary.en: Google AI, Grok and Claude require report settings to be enabled.
summary.zh: Google AI、Grok、Claude 需在报表设置中启用。

description.en: Compare location-level filters and the ability to switch between store and brand views. A brand-wide visibility summary alone does not answer which store or local topic needs attention.
description.zh: 重点比较门店级筛选及品牌／门店视图切换能力。品牌整体曝光汇总不能单独回答具体哪家门店或哪个本地主题需要处理。

description.en: Analyze AI crawler activity alongside AI answer visibility and website data.
description.zh: 结合网站数据与 AI 回答曝光，分析 AI 爬虫的访问活动。

en: Use website logs to distinguish AI training, indexing and assistant bot activity; bot visits do not prove answer citations.
The optional AI Visibility dashboard measures brand mentions and citations across ChatGPT, Perplexity and Google AI Mode.
zh: 通过网站日志区分 AI 训练、索引与助手爬虫活动；爬虫访问不代表页面已被回答引用。
可选的 AI Visibility 面板衡量 ChatGPT、Perplexity 与 Google AI Mode 中的品牌提及和引用。

audience.en: Enterprise SEO and technical teams studying AI access to their own websites.
audience.zh: 需要分析 AI 如何访问自有网站的企业 SEO 与技术团队。

description.en: When investigating AI discovery, inspect server-log bot activity and, if enabled, answer visibility reports separately to distinguish crawling from mentions and citations.
description.zh: 调查 AI 发现情况时，分别查看服务器日志中的爬虫活动，以及已启用的回答曝光报告，区分抓取、提及和引用。

summary.en: Investigate AI crawling separately from answer visibility.
summary.zh: 分开调查 AI 抓取与回答曝光。

label.zh: Botify AI 爬虫分类与日志分析

label.en: Botify AI Visibility coverage and data prerequisites
label.zh: Botify AI Visibility 覆盖与数据前提

label.en: Botify subscription plans and feature limits
label.zh: Botify 订阅方案与功能限制
Botify 销售与演示联系

description.en: Pricing is provided through a sales agreement or tailored package. No fixed public amount for this feature was verified; confirm the monitoring scope, required integrations and contract term in the quote.
description.zh: 费用通过销售协议或定制方案确定。本轮未核实到该功能的固定公开金额，需在报价中确认监测范围、必要集成和合同期限。

summary.en: Custom quote; confirm monitoring modules and data integrations.
summary.zh: 定制询价，确认监测模块及数据集成。

description.en: GSC-based prompt campaigns require connected GSC data, while AI Discovery reporting requires server traffic data.
description.zh: 基于 GSC 的提示词监测需要接入 GSC 数据；AI Discovery 报告需要服务器流量数据。

summary.en: GSC-based monitoring needs GSC; AI Discovery needs server traffic data.
summary.zh: GSC 监测需接入 GSC；AI Discovery 需服务器流量数据。

description.en: Assess server-log analysis and the optional AI Visibility dashboard as different modules. A project needing crawler diagnosis may need server data, while answer monitoring requires the relevant visibility setup.
description.zh: 应将服务器日志分析与可选的 AI Visibility 看板作为不同模块评估。爬虫诊断项目可能需要服务器数据，回答监测则需相应曝光配置。

description.en: Monitor technical website changes that can affect AI and search visibility.
description.zh: 监测可能影响 AI 与搜索曝光的网站技术变化。

en: Continuously detect technical AEO and SEO issues and prioritize affected pages.
Route change alerts to relevant teams and review page snapshots and change history.
zh: 持续检测技术 AEO 与 SEO 问题，确定需优先处理的页面。
向相关团队发送变更告警，并查看页面快照与变更历史。

audience.en: Website and SEO teams monitoring technical changes that may reduce AI discoverability.
audience.zh: 需要监测技术变化、防止 AI 可发现性下降的网站与 SEO 团队。

description.en: When a monitored page changes, use alerts, snapshots and change history to investigate technical AEO or SEO issues before prioritizing fixes.
description.zh: 被监测页面发生变化时，通过告警、快照与变更历史调查技术 AEO 或 SEO 问题，再安排修复优先级。

summary.en: Investigate technical changes using alerts and page history.
summary.zh: 通过告警及页面历史调查技术变更。

label.en: Conductor Monitoring technical AEO and change detection
label.zh: Conductor Monitoring 技术 AEO 与变更检测

label.en: Conductor plans, monitoring limits and sales consultation
label.zh: Conductor 方案、监测限制与销售咨询

description.en: Pricing is provided through a sales agreement or tailored package. No fixed public amount for this feature was verified; confirm the monitoring scope, required integrations and contract term in the quote.
description.zh: 费用通过销售协议或定制方案确定。本轮未核实到该功能的固定公开金额，需在报价中确认监测范围、必要集成和合同期限。

summary.en: Custom quote by monitoring scope and contract.
summary.zh: 按监测范围及合同定制询价。

description.en: Monitoring capacity and history depend on the subscription; the free offer is a limited trial.
description.zh: 监测规模与历史保留取决于订阅方案；免费入口为限时试用。

summary.en: Monitoring scale and retained history depend on plan; limited trial.
summary.zh: 监测规模与历史保留按套餐区分；免费仅限试用。

description.en: Prioritize it for ongoing technical change detection, alerts and page history. Compare retained history and monitoring scale against the technical workflow rather than treating it as only an AI answer-tracking allowance.
description.zh: 可优先用于持续技术变更检测、告警和页面历史。应按技术工作流比较历史保留与监测规模，而非只把它当作 AI 回答追踪额度。

description.en: Trace cited pages and compare how AI answers mention and describe your brand.
description.zh: 追溯被引页面，对比 AI 回答如何提及和描述品牌。

en: Review original AI answers, cited domains and pages, and the source passages behind citation markers.
Track brand mentions, competitive share and sentiment by country and prompt.
zh: 查看 AI 回答原文、被引域名与页面，以及引用标记对应的来源段落。
按国家与提示词追踪品牌提及、竞争份额和情绪。

audience.en: Consumer brands and agencies investigating AI citation sources across markets.
audience.zh: 需要跨市场研究 AI 引用来源的消费品牌与代理机构。

description.zh: 通过重复提示词采样，比较 AI 回答中的品牌提及、引用与竞品。

en: Use suggested or custom prompts and run each prompt multiple times to inspect visibility and average positions.
Compare competitor brands and investigate the sources cited in AI responses.
zh: 使用建议或自定义提示词，重复采样并分析曝光和平均位置。
比较竞品品牌，研究 AI 回答引用的来源。

audience.en: Marketers and small SEO teams starting with a limited recurring AI prompt set.
audience.zh: 从少量持续 AI 提示词监测起步的营销人员和小型 SEO 团队。

description.en: When starting a small monitoring set, use suggested or custom questions and repeated answer samples to compare brand positions, competitors and cited sources.
description.zh: 从少量问题开始监测时，使用建议或自定义问题及重复回答样本，比较品牌位置、竞品和引用来源。

summary.en: Start with a small, repeatedly sampled question set.
summary.zh: 用少量问题及重复采样开始监测。

label.en: Mangools AI Search Watcher features and engines
label.zh: Mangools AI Search Watcher 功能与引擎

label.en: AI Search Watcher monitoring guide and free-plan limits
label.zh: AI Search Watcher 监测指南与免费方案限制

description.en: The official guide documents a continuing Free plan with five monitored prompts and one monitor, updated weekly. Higher capacity is available through paid plans; a fixed current paid amount was not verified in the guide.
description.zh: 官方指南列出持续免费方案，含 5 个监测提示词和 1 个 monitor，按周更新。更高容量由付费方案提供；指南未核实到当前固定付费金额。

summary.en: Free: five prompts, one monitor, weekly updates. Paid amount unconfirmed.
summary.zh: 免费 5 提示词、1 个 monitor、每周更新；付费金额待确认。

description.en: The official guide documents an ongoing free plan with limited prompts and weekly updates, plus paid plans with larger monitoring allowances.
description.zh: 官方指南列出持续免费方案，提示词数量有限且按周更新；付费方案提供更高监测额度。

summary.en: Free tier has limited prompts and weekly updates; paid plans raise capacity.
summary.zh: 免费档提示词有限、每周更新；付费提高容量。

description.en: Use the five-prompt Free plan to evaluate a small recurring question set. Compare update cadence and repeated samples before upgrading, rather than assuming a free report offers the same capacity as a paid monitoring setup.
description.zh: 可用五提示词 Free 方案评估少量持续问题。升级前应比较更新频率和重复采样，不假设免费报告与付费监测配置容量相同。

description.en: Research AI brand mentions and cited sources, then compare competitors with custom prompt monitoring.
description.zh: 研究 AI 品牌提及与引用来源，并用自定义提示词监测比较竞品。

en: Explore brand mentions, cited URLs and the entities or competitors appearing in the same answer context.
Track selected prompts over time and organize them by topic, model or campaign.
zh: 研究品牌提及、引用 URL，以及相同回答语境中的实体和竞品。
持续监测选定提示词，按主题、模型或营销活动组织分析。

audience.en: SEO and brand teams comparing AI answer visibility alongside an existing search-analysis workflow.
audience.zh: 需要在现有搜索分析流程中比较 AI 回答曝光的 SEO 与品牌团队。

description.en: When reviewing a campaign or topic, organize recurring prompts and investigate which entities, competitors and cited URLs appear in the same answer context.
description.zh: 复盘营销活动或主题时，组织持续监测的提示词，调查同一回答语境中的实体、竞品和引用 URL。

summary.en: Research entities, competitors and citations by topic.
summary.zh: 按主题研究实体、竞品及引用。

label.en: SISTRIX AI Visibility product and tracked platforms
label.zh: SISTRIX AI Visibility 产品与监测平台
SISTRIX 自定义提示词监测指南

label.en: SISTRIX paid packages and AI beta conditions
label.zh: SISTRIX 付费套餐与 AI 测试条件

description.en: SISTRIX Start is €119/month plus taxes; Plus €239, Professional €419 and Premium €799. AI analysis is included as a beta in paid packages, rather than a separately verified free AI plan.
description.zh: SISTRIX Start 为 €119/月另加税，Plus €239、Professional €419、Premium €799。AI 分析作为测试功能包含在付费套餐中，不是已核实的独立免费 AI 方案。

summary.en: Start €119/month plus tax; AI beta included in paid packages.
summary.zh: Start €119/月另加税；AI 测试功能随付费套餐提供。

description.en: AI analysis is currently a beta inclusion in paid SISTRIX packages; included beta access and the time-limited trial are not a standalone free plan.
description.zh: AI 分析目前作为测试功能包含在 SISTRIX 付费套餐内；测试期包含和限时试用不代表独立免费方案。

summary.en: Beta inclusion and a trial do not establish a standalone free AI plan.
summary.zh: 测试期包含与限时试用不等于独立免费 AI 方案。

description.en: Compare how AI topic and prompt research fits an existing SISTRIX workflow. Beta inclusion in a paid SEO package is different from buying a standalone free AI tracker; review the package and additional-user costs.
description.zh: 应比较 AI 主题／提示词研究如何衔接现有 SISTRIX 流程。付费 SEO 套餐中的测试功能与独立免费 AI 追踪器不同，还需核对套餐及额外用户费用。

description.en: Connect AI visibility and citation insights with content briefs, drafts and refresh workflows.
description.zh: 将 AI 曝光与引用洞察接入内容简报、草稿和更新流程。

en: Use prompt research, source analysis and competitor gaps to plan content for AI search.
Generate and refresh content using company context, with content-agent and publishing capabilities depending on the plan.
zh: 结合提示词研究、来源分析和竞品缺口，规划面向 AI 搜索的内容。
利用企业背景生成并更新内容；内容 Agent 及发布能力取决于方案。

audience.en: Content and growth teams turning AI search research into ongoing editorial work.
audience.zh: 需要将 AI 搜索研究转化为持续内容工作的内容与增长团队。

description.en: When planning content work, combine prompt research, citation sources and competitor gaps, then review generated or refreshed drafts using company context.
description.zh: 规划内容工作时，结合提示词研究、引用来源与竞品缺口，再根据企业背景审核生成或更新的草稿。

summary.en: Turn prompt and citation research into reviewed content.
summary.zh: 将提示词及引用研究转化为经审核内容。

label.en: Cognizo AI search and content workflows
label.zh: Cognizo AI 搜索与内容工作流

label.en: Cognizo plan features and engine coverage
label.zh: Cognizo 方案功能与引擎覆盖

description.en: Growth is $499/month and Pro $999/month; Enterprise is custom-priced. Content output, monitored platforms and agent or publishing access depend on the package.
description.zh: Growth 为 $499/月，Pro 为 $999/月，Enterprise 定制报价。内容产出、监测平台以及 Agent 或发布权限取决于套餐。

summary.en: Growth $499/month; Pro $999; Enterprise quoted. Content and agent access vary.
summary.zh: Growth $499/月，Pro $999，企业版询价；内容及 Agent 权限按档位。

description.en: Growth and Pro list five monitored AI platforms; Enterprise lists additional platforms and custom limits. Public plans are paid subscriptions.
description.zh: Growth 和 Pro 列出五个监测平台；Enterprise 提供更多平台及定制额度。公开方案采用付费订阅。

summary.en: Growth/Pro list five engines; Enterprise adds coverage/custom limits.
summary.zh: Growth／Pro 列出 5 引擎；企业版扩展覆盖及额度。

description.en: Select by the content production and publishing workflow as well as prompt monitoring. Growth and Pro list five monitored platforms, while expanded coverage and custom limits are an Enterprise consideration.
description.zh: 应同时按内容生产／发布流程和提示词监测选型。Growth 与 Pro 列出五个监测平台，扩展覆盖及定制额度则需评估 Enterprise。

description.en: Monitor brand visibility and competitor citations across Chinese and global AI answer engines.
description.zh: 监测品牌在中文及全球 AI 回答引擎中的曝光与竞品引用。

en: Compare brands on buyer-intent prompts and inspect visibility, sentiment, positions and cited sources.
Drill down from summary metrics to original AI answers and use daily updates, weekly reports and data exports.
zh: 围绕买家意图问题比较品牌，查看曝光、情绪、位置和引用来源。
从汇总指标下钻到原始 AI 回答，使用每日更新、周报和数据导出。

audience.en: Cross-border brands comparing AI search visibility in Chinese and international markets.
audience.zh: 需要比较中文与海外市场 AI 搜索曝光的跨境品牌。

description.en: When reviewing buyer-intent questions, compare brands on visibility and sentiment, then drill into original answers and cited sources to explain differences.
description.zh: 复盘买家意图问题时，比较品牌曝光和情绪，再下钻到原始回答与引用来源以了解差异。

summary.en: Investigate buyer-intent answers, sentiment and citations.
summary.zh: 研究买家意图回答、情绪与引用。

label.zh: Geolix 监测看板、平台与方案

label.en: Geolix product identity and market coverage
label.zh: Geolix 产品身份与市场覆盖
